summary: Delulu Phase B (identity-aware story engine) backend + frontend regression. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass — GET/POST /api/users/identity (defaults female/men, analytics_events 'identity_set' inserted with matching props, firstSave returned); POST /api/story/cast (female/men → rian=masc, female/women → rian=femme, needsPicker=[], second call idempotent — no double-fire li_cast_selected); POST /api/story/cast with {castings:{rian:masc}} override wins + analytics fires with source='override' + db.users.storyCastings updated; POST /api/endings/record inserts analytics_events story_complete row with props.castings populated; admin endpoints: 401 {detail:'admin credentials required'} without X-Admin-Pass, exactly 32 stories sorted worst-first with X-Admin-Pass, validate falling_for_the_enigma returns canGoLive=true + hard_coded_pronoun finding + incomplete_portraits warnings on rian for both masc+femme referencing 'surprised'; preview /admin/preview with {playerGender:female, castings:{rian:femme}} yields 'She slides a second glass across the bar' and with {rian:masc} yields 'He slides a second glass across the bar'. Frontend flows validated at 390x844 as test1@delulu.dev: (1) After identity reset to female/men via API, /identity Step A shows exactly 3 gender options (identity-gender-female|male|nonbinary) and after identity-next Step B shows exactly 4 romance options (identity-romance-men|women|everyone|surprise); identity-done navigates to /profile. (2) /profile shows profile-my-identity element with text 'my identity female · loves men'. (3) /admin gate has admin-pass + admin-auth testIDs; wrong passphrase — the code triggers Alert.alert('auth failed'…) which is a no-op on RN Web so no dialog is observable (KNOWN RN-Web limitation carried over from iter5, unchanged from Phase A). Correct passphrase 'delulu-admin-2026' loads 32 admin-story-<id> rows; tapping admin-story-falling_for_the_enigma renders findings (hard_coded_pronoun warnings visible) and variantIssues (incomplete_portraits · rian for masc & femme). (4) Reader token integration: /reader/falling_for_the_enigma?chapter=0 with test user (female/men, storyCastings.falling_for_the_enigma.rian='masc') advances autoplay past the target line and renders 'He slides a second glass across the bar without asking.' — NOT the raw '{c_rian_they}' token. (5) Phase A regressions clean: home dedupe (hero=falling_for_the_enigma via home-flagship-hero, featured=6 s20/s13/s02/s01/burn_notice/s30, story-card=25, 0 duplicates across buckets); search 32 cards with 2:3 aspect (160.4/241.7=0.6639, delta<0.5%); gems shows 'claim my daily delulu' CTA, no 'mock' text, exactly 1 day-cell-today; profile identity persists after reload. ONE Phase-B UI GAP FOUND: the admin 'preview any identity' bar only exposes gender chips (female/male/nonbinary) + chapter index + render — it has NO UI to pick per-character castings, and the request body sends `castings: {}` always. As a result, tapping admin-preview-gender-male + admin-preview-run renders 'They slides a second glass across the bar' (unresolved they with no verb agreement) instead of 'He slides…' expected by the review. Backend is correct — the same POST /admin/preview call with an explicit castings map returns He/She as spec'd (confirmed in pytest). This is a frontend-only gap in /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'preview any identity' UI has no casting selector — previewParams.castings stays {} so POST /api/admin/preview never receives per-character castings. With gender=male the response renders 'They slides a second glass across the bar' (unresolved {c_rian_they} → 'they' + no verb agreement) rather than the expected 'He slides…'. Also the 'they' fallback yields subject-verb mismatch. Reference: app/admin.tsx:23, 50-58, 161-183

integration_issues.issue: Frontend does not surface a castings selector so admin can never render the masc/femme variants from the UI even though the /api/admin/preview endpoint supports it. Backend is correct; frontend must add per-character variant chips (masc/femme) and merge into previewParams.castings before calling adminApi.preview.

react_native_issues.issue: Wrong passphrase path calls Alert.alert which is a no-op on RN Web — the admin gate silently ignores the 401 in the web preview (spinner clears, no visible error). Native builds are fine, but on web there is zero feedback for bad passwords. Consider a cross-platform toast/error banner or window.confirm equivalent. Reference: app/admin.tsx:34
Still emitting deprecation warnings across the app (carried over from iter5). Non-blocking.

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx add per-character variant chips (masc/femme) below the gender picker in the preview bar, wire them into previewParams.castings, so 'render' actually resolves {c_rian_they} to He/She. Backend POST /api/admin/preview already accepts castings: {charId:'masc'|'femme'} and returns 'He/She slides a second glass across the bar' correctly.

In /app/backend/token_engine.py (or wherever tokens are resolved) consider a defensive fallback: if a character has no casting and the token is a subject pronoun (c_X_they), avoid rendering 'They slides' — either use 'They slide' (plural agreement) or fall back to the character's name. Currently 'They slides a second glass' appears in the admin preview when no casting is selected.
Optional (RN-Web polish, carried from iter5): replace Alert.alert on the web target with a cross-platform confirm/toast so the admin gate's 'auth failed' error is actually visible on web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend Phase B core is solid: /api/users/identity persists correctly, first-save analytics is fired only on transition from null identitySetAt, li_cast_selected differentiates source='preference' vs 'override' and dedupes on newly_cast so second identical /story/cast call is a true no-op.
story_complete analytics event includes props.castings populated with the resolved casting — validated end-to-end after POST /api/endings/record.
Admin gate _require_admin correctly returns 401 with {detail:'admin credentials required'} when header missing (matches spec exactly).
Admin stories list is sorted by (-errors, -warnings, id) — verified errors array is monotonically non-increasing.
Frontend identity.tsx (Step A / Step B / done) and profile-my-identity wiring is complete and testID coverage is correct.
Admin preview UI is incomplete: castings state exists in previewParams but no UI writes to it. This is the one Phase B UI gap.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 iter6 Phase B) + 15/15 iter5 Phase A already validated
success_rate.frontend: 6/7 Phase B checks pass; admin preview castings UI missing (1 gap). Phase A regressions all pass.

seed_data_creation: None. Reused seeded test1@delulu.dev. Test toggled identity to male/women during POST /identity test, then reset to female/men. TestStoryCast$unset'd storyCastings.falling_for_the_enigma before each casting test so the preference/override path was exercised deterministically; final state ends with rian=masc for female/men (matches spec baseline).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B backend is 100% verified via /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_phaseB_identity.py (13 tests). One frontend gap remains: the admin panel preview cannot exercise per-character castings from the UI (see action_items). Once main agent adds casting chips in admin.tsx and re-checks admin-preview-run, this iteration is closeable. Reader token resolution is confirmed working end-to-end ('He slides a second glass across the bar without asking.' rendered for female/men+rian=masc, no raw {c_rian_they}). Test user ends in a clean state: identity=female/men, storyCastings.falling_for_the_enigma.rian='masc', analytics_events grew by expected identity_set + li_cast_selected + story_complete rows.
rca_of_issue: Admin preview rendering 'They slides a second glass' RCA: /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx line 23 initializes previewParams with castings:{}. The preview bar (lines 161-183) only exposes gender chips + chapter input + render button. There is no state setter for castings; runPreview() at line 50 forwards previewParams verbatim to adminApi.preview. POST /api/admin/preview then calls resolve_tokens with castings={}, which for {c_rian_they} defaults to lowercase 'they' (uppercased to 'They' because it is the sentence start). No verb agreement is applied, hence 'They slides…'. Fix: add masc/femme chips per love-interest character and merge into previewParams.castings before calling render; optional backend hardening — pluralize the verb when 'they' is chosen as pronoun fallback.
